text:
Which statement about acids is correct?
A
A weak acid partially dissociates in aqueous solution.
B
An acid accepts protons when added to water.
C
Ethanoic acid acts as a strong acid when added to water.
Hydrochloric acid is a strong acid that ionises in water to form H– ions.
D

options.label: A
options.text: A weak acid partially dissociates in aqueous solution.

options.label: B
options.text: An acid accepts protons when added to water.

options.label: C
options.text: Ethanoic acid acts as a strong acid when added to water.

options.label: D
options.text: Hydrochloric acid is a strong acid that ionises in water to form H– ions.
